name: hcapp_processThirdPartyLogin
description: REFUSED since 2026-10-17 (errorCode 1306, errorType 13, logged as 'Third-party sign-in refused') until Apple/Google sign-in is rebuilt with server-side token verification (E1.F1.S8): it trusted provider ids and email sent by the caller. Original behaviour, kept below the refusal for the rebuild: Handles OAuth sign-in (Apple, Google; the Facebook branch is a defunct-integration leftover). Resolves an existing Hasher by thirdPartyUserId, email or thirdPartyEmail (five-way OR, TOP 1), updating the OAuth token fields, name, photo (only if none) and Removed = 0 when found; inserts a new Hasher otherwise (Preferences 14 + USA-miles flag from the device location, IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory from the parameter or 0). When thirdPartyLoginType = 'facebook' it also copies the token onto any HC.Kennel whose KennelFacebookTokenUsername matches either email. Auth: does NOT use HC6.ValidateAppAuth — it reads HC.Device itself (errorCode 1305 / type 13 when the device is unknown or has no user) and calls HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 with the compound context DeviceSecret + UPPER(userId) (errorCode 1105 / type 11 on failure). No permission gate: the device's own user is the one signed in. Write SP: envelope at rowset 0; on success the resolved hasher's profile at rowset 1, on failure the error detail at rowset 1.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used to resolve userId and DeviceSecret for compound token validation. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against DeviceSecret + UPPER(userId) compound. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version string. Recorded in HC.ErrorLog on error. No SQL default.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: First name from OAuth provider. Applied via COALESCE on update (preserves existing value if NULL). No SQL default.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Last name from OAuth provider. Applied via COALESCE on update. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hashName
parameters.description: Hash name. Empty string normalised to NULL before use. Applied via COALESCE on update (preserves existing value if NULL/empty). No SQL default.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Primary email from OAuth provider. Used in hasher resolution lookup and update. No SQL default.

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description: Profile photo URL. Empty string normalised to NULL. On update: COALESCE(existing, @photo, generated bundle avatar) — photo is NOT overwritten if already set. No SQL default.

parameters.name: thirdPartyLoginType
parameters.description: OAuth provider identifier: 'apple' or 'google'. 'facebook' still drives the FacebookId/FacebookAccessToken writes and the HC.Kennel token copy, but the Facebook integration is defunct (CLAUDE.md, 2026-10-10). No SQL default.

parameters.name: thirdPartyUserId
parameters.description: OAuth provider's user identifier. Primary key for hasher resolution. No SQL default.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAccessToken
parameters.description: OAuth access token stored against the hasher. Also stored in Hasher.FacebookAccessToken when loginType='facebook'. No SQL default.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAuthorizationCode
parameters.description: OAuth authorization code. No SQL default.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAccessTokenExpires
parameters.description: Token expiry. Defaults to '2100-01-01' via COALESCE when NULL. HC6 uses native DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — no longer a brittle NVARCHAR cast.

parameters.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL at entry (means do not update). On the insert path, NULL defaults to 0. On the update path, this parameter is NOT applied — the existing value is always preserved regardless.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Device latitude. Default 0. Used for the USA-miles detection and stored as HomeLatitude on the INSERT path only; not stored on the update path.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(18,15) vs Hasher.HomeLatitude DECIMAL(12,9). Parameter has higher precision than the column.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Device longitude. Default 0. Used for the USA-miles detection and stored as HomeLongitude on the INSERT path only; not stored on the update path.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(19,15) vs Hasher.HomeLongitude DECIMAL(13,9). Parameter has higher precision than the column.

parameters.name: thirdPartyEmail
parameters.description: Email as reported directly by the OAuth provider (may differ from @email). Used as a secondary resolution key. No SQL default.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always present as rowset 0. success=1 on success (NULL errorCode/errorType). success=0 on any error path.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Error-specific code on failure (1305=device not found, 1105=bad token, 1905=user not created or db error).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 11=auth, 13=hasher not found, 19=user creation failure or unhandled db error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on any error path (device not found, invalid token, user not created, CATCH). Standard HC6 error detail shape.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification. 11=invalid token, 13=hasher not found, 19=user creation failure or unhandled error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. 1305=device not registered, 1105=invalid access token, 1905=user not created or db error.

rowsets.name: HasherProfile
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on success. Full profile of the resolved (or newly created) hasher.

columns.name: hasherId
columns.description: Hasher.id. SQL emits it upper-case; the API's JSON lowercases it.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Hasher.updatedAt. HC6 returns native DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — no longer cast to NVARCHAR.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher — OAuth token fields, HashName/Email/FirstName/LastName (COALESCE: parameter wins when non-NULL), Photo only if currently NULL, ThirdPartyAccessTokenExpires (2100-01-01 when NULL), Facebook* columns (NULL unless loginType = 'facebook'), Removed = 0, updatedAt — when an existing hasher is resolved (lines 146-165).
INSERT HC.Hasher — new account with NameDisplayPreference 1 (hash name given) or 2, Preferences = 14 + useUsaMiles, HomeLatitude/HomeLongitude from the parameters (lines 172-196).

UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelFacebookToken, KennelFacebookTokenLastUpdated — when loginType = 'facebook', for kennels whose KennelFacebookTokenUsername matches @email or @thirdPartyEmail (lines 200-207). Defunct integration; removable when touched.

INSERT HC.ErrorLog — device not registered (1305), invalid token (1105), account not found after commit (1905, logged with userId = empty GUID, deviceId = @thirdPartyEmail, string_1 = @email), unhandled CATCH (1905).

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @hcVersion, @thirdPartyLoginType, @thirdPartyUserId, @thirdPartyAccessToken, @thirdPartyAuthorizationCode, @thirdPartyEmail. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Facebook-only code in the sign-in path
codeSmells.detail: Lines 160-162, 175, 188-190 and 200-207 exist only for the defunct Facebook integration (CLAUDE.md 2026-10-10): FacebookId / FacebookAccessToken / FacebookAccessTokenLastUpdated on HC.Hasher and the HC.Kennel KennelFacebookToken* copy. They may be removed whenever this SP is next edited; the Fb* mirror columns on HC.Event are a different thing and must stay.

codeSmells.issue: Post-commit verification uses narrower matching than the upsert
codeSmells.detail: Lines 215-220 re-find the account with four of the five OR terms used at 135-141 (the 'ThirdPartyEmail = @email' cross-match is dropped). A hasher resolved only through that term is updated and committed, then reported as 'Account creation failed' (1905) — a false error after a successful write.

@latitude DECIMAL(18,15) is inserted into Hasher.HomeLatitude DECIMAL(12,9); @longitude DECIMAL(19,15) into HomeLongitude DECIMAL(13,9). Silent rounding to 9 decimals on the INSERT path (harmless in practice: 9 decimals is ~0.1 mm). The USA detection uses the parameters directly.

codeSmells.issue: Hasher resolution uses TOP 1 without ORDER BY
codeSmells.detail: If two hashers match the five-way OR at lines 135-141 (for example one by ThirdPartyUserId and another by a shared Email), TOP 1 picks an arbitrary one and the OAuth identity is attached to it. The post-merge world (E12.F6) makes this rarer, not impossible.

codeSmells.issue: Error log row misuses deviceId and userId
codeSmells.detail: Lines 225-228 write userId = '00000000-...' and deviceId = @thirdPartyEmail. The device id is known (@deviceId) and the user is @userId; the email belongs in string_1 (where @email already goes) or string_2.

codeSmells.issue: Auth and normalisation run outside TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 74-125 (empty-string normalisation, HC.Device lookup, HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2) are not wrapped. A runtime error there is an unlogged raw 500. Pre-flight checks may sit outside the TRY by convention, but the token function call is the one most likely to fail transiently.

codeSmells.issue: @includeInGlobalHashDirectory sentinel -1 has no effect on the update path
codeSmells.detail: Line 77 maps -1 to NULL, but the update at 146-165 never touches IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory, so for an existing hasher the parameter is ignored whatever its value; only the INSERT path uses it (NULL => 0). Also, per CLAUDE.md this flag must never be used in logic — it is stored here only.

breakingChanges: @deviceId type changed from NVARCHAR(50) to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — callers passing string UUIDs must now use typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER binding
@firstName/@lastName/@hashName/@email widened from NVARCHAR(120) to NVARCHAR(250) — non-breaking for callers but fixes silent truncation of values between 121-250 chars
@photo narrowed from NVARCHAR(2000) to NVARCHAR(1000) to match Hasher.Photo — values over 1000 chars will now be rejected by SQL Server parameter binding rather than silently truncated at insert
@thirdPartyEmail widened from NVARCHAR(120) to NVARCHAR(250) to match Hasher.ThirdPartyEmail — non-breaking for callers
@thirdPartyAccessTokenExpires type changed from NVARCHAR(150) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers must pass a typed datetime value, not a date string
@hashersUpdatedAfter parameter removed — this dead parameter was accepted but never used in HC5; callers must remove it from their call signatures
HasherProfile rowset column updatedAt type changed from NVARCHAR(50) (local-time string) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers must parse a typed datetime value instead of a formatted string

Auth error format changed from non-standard Pascal-cased single rowset (HC5 rowset 0: ErrorType/ErrorTitle/ErrorDescription) to standard HC6 two-rowset format (rowset 0: success envelope + rowset 1: error detail)
Hardcoded FILTH Leiden HasherKennelMap insert for new users removed — new users are no longer auto-followed to any kennel on registration
Success envelope (rowset 0: success/errorCode/errorType) added as a new leading rowset — callers expecting HasherProfile as rowset 0 must shift to rowset 1

1.1.0 (2026-10-13): contract corrections only — auth described as it is (own device lookup + CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2, not ValidateAppAuth), envelope success typed INT, parameters marked as having no SQL default, Facebook code flagged as defunct.
